units.characteristics: the God-pleasing self drawing peace; the ordering LORD
units.gist: everything for its purpose; when a man's ways please the LORD even his enemies are at peace; the just balance is the LORD's - inner alignment with God as the source of outer peace

units.characteristics: the self that reads and appeases power; right speech winning favour
units.gist: the king's wrath a messenger of death, favour like spring rain, righteous lips his delight; the wise interior reads and appeases the disposition (w/ Ecc 10:4)

units.characteristics: the interior that values righteousness/wisdom over gain
units.gist: better little with righteousness than much with injustice; wisdom better than gold - the reordered value-ranking of the inner being (w/ Ps 119:72)
the upright's highway turns from evil, guarding his way preserves his life; good sense a fountain of life; gray hair a crown gained in righteousness (w/ 4:23)

units.characteristics: malice legible in speech and gesture
units.gist: the worthless man's scorching speech, the strife-spreader, the whisperer separating friends, the violent enticer, the winking schemer; driving appetite (w/ 6:12-14)
a dry morsel with quiet better than a house full of feasting with strife (w/ Ecc 4:6)

units.characteristics: the heart legible in what it hears/speaks; the self-ensnaring tongue
units.gist: the evildoer listens to wicked lips; fine speech unbecoming a fool; the crooked heart finds no good, the dishonest tongue falls into calamity (w/ Ecc 10:12)

units.characteristics: the shared-Maker conscience; gladness-at-calamity as a fault
units.gist: mocking the poor insults his Maker; glad at calamity will not go unpunished (w/ Job 31:15,29)
a bribe is a magic stone in the GIVER'S eyes (wherever he turns he prospers); secret bribe perverting justice - corruption distorting the interior's seeing

units.characteristics: the strife-loving, rebellion-seeking heart; strife as an un-dammable flood
units.gist: the evil man seeks rebellion; better a she-bear than a fool in folly; returning evil for good; the beginning of strife like letting out water; loving transgression loves strife
justifying the wicked / condemning the righteous both abomination; fining the righteous not good (w/ Isa 5:20)

units.characteristics: folly as the family's grief; wisdom as the true inheritance
units.gist: the wise servant over the shameful son; money uselessly in a fool's hand; the fool a sorrow/grief/bitterness to his parents (thread w/ 10:1, 23:24-25; wisdom un-purchasable w/ Job 28:15)
one who lacks sense gives a pledge in the presence of his neighbour (thread w/ 6:1-5)
